# Task handoff

- Issue/slice, human owner, base/head commit:
- Problem addressed and externally visible behavior:
- Changed files and scope deviations:
- Red evidence: command, assertion failure, pre-fix revision:
- Green evidence: commands/results; controls and checks not run:
- Reproduction/minimal fixture and provenance:
- Runtime/artifact/memory impact when relevant:
- Remaining limitations and parent acceptance not satisfied:
- Usage: Copilot session/credits/wall time; coordinator review minutes; corrective iterations:
- Integration status: not reviewed / changes requested / validated / landed:

Do not describe self-authored tests alone as independent acceptance. Keep raw tool logs, credentials and private session exports out of commits.
